accountDisabled.title: Account Disabled
accountDisabled.description: Your account is currently disabled. All your data is preserved, but you won't have access to most features until you reactivate.

accountScheduledForDeletion.title: Account Scheduled for Deletion
accountScheduledForDeletion.deletedOnPrefix: Your account is scheduled to be permanently deleted on
accountScheduledForDeletion.afterDate: After this date, all your data will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered.

dataImport.title: Data Import
dataImport.description: Import your business data from CSV or Excel files to populate your account.

resetAllData.title: Reset All Data
resetAllData.description: This will permanently delete all appointments, customers, and services. This action cannot be undone.

disableAccount.title: Disable Account
disableAccount.description: Temporarily disable your account. Your data will be preserved, and you can reactivate anytime by logging back in.
disableAccount.ownerHint: As an owner, you must remove all team members before disabling your account.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.description: Schedule your account for permanent deletion. After 30 days, all data will be permanently removed.
deleteAccount.gracePeriod: During the 30-day grace period, you can log in and cancel the deletion to keep your account.
deleteAccount.ownerHint: As an owner, you must remove all team members before deleting your account.

mustLeaveOrganisations.title: Must Leave All Organisations
mustLeaveOrganisations.memberCount_one: You are currently a member of 1 organisation.
mustLeaveOrganisations.memberCount_other: You are currently a member of {{count}} organisations.
mustLeaveOrganisations.hint: You must leave all organisations before you can deactivate or delete your account. Log in to each business and use the "Leave Organisation" option in your settings.

blockersDialog.title: Resolve these before disabling or deleting
blockersDialog.description: Please resolve the following before you can disable or delete your account.

teamMembersError.title: Team Members Must Be Removed
teamMembersError.message: You must remove all {{count}} team member(s) before performing this action.
teamMembersError.goToHint: Go to Assignments to manage and remove team members from your business.

cancelDeletion.title: Cancel Account Deletion
cancelDeletion.message: Are you sure you want to cancel the scheduled deletion and keep your account?

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate Account
deactivateDialog.inactive: Your account will be marked as inactive.
deactivateDialog.reactivateHint: You can reactivate it anytime by simply logging back in. All your data will be preserved.
deactivateDialog.marketplaceWarning: Warning: Your business will be delisted from the marketplace.

deleteAccountDialog.title: Delete Account
deleteAccountDialog.scheduled: Your account will be scheduled for permanent deletion in 30 days.
deleteAccountDialog.periodHint: During this period, you can log in and cancel the deletion. After 30 days, your account and all data will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.
deleteAccountDialog.marketplaceWarning: Warning: Your business will be delisted from the marketplace.

deletionScheduledSuccess.title: Account Scheduled for Deletion
deletionScheduledSuccess.scheduled: Your account has been scheduled for deletion.
deletionScheduledSuccess.cancelHint: You can cancel this by logging back in before the deletion date.

leaveOrganisation.title: Leave Organisation
leaveOrganisation.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to leave this organisation?
leaveOrganisation.confirmHint: You will lose access to this business and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
leaveOrganisation.successMessage: You have successfully left the organisation.
leaveOrganisation.successHint: Your access to this business has been removed. You will now be logged out.

activeAppointments.title: Active Appointments Found
activeAppointments.message_one: You have 1 active appointment that must be resolved before you can leave.
activeAppointments.message_other: You have {{count}} active appointments that must be resolved before you can leave.
activeAppointments.hint: Please cancel your pending appointments or ask the business owner to reassign them to another team member before trying again.
